$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only. Pins of the Pulsar Seat stream-server build (stream-server/build-sunshine.ps1, docs in stream-server/README.md). Upstream source is fetched by commit SHA (tag only for humans) into target/wf/sunshine-src; sunshine-patches/*.patch apply in name order. Every download is pinned by URL + SHA-256 (GitHub release asset digests, read with the GitHub REST API on 2026-11-17). MSYS2 packages come from the MSYS2 repositories at build time (pacman verifies the MSYS2 package signatures; the repositories are rolling, so the exact package versions are recorded in the build record, not pinned).

arm64.$cxx_flags: upstream's libdisplaydevice submodule misses <vector> / <type_traits> / <iterator> includes that newer libc++ no longer pulls in transitively; force-included here because patches cannot reach submodule files
